The Apple deals are flying now that Amazon’s 2026 Black Friday sale is officially live, but we are also tracking some particularly notable deals on Beats gear. While the AirPods Pro 3 deal is now live at $70 off and, as of this morning, an even lower price on the 2026 AirPods Max 2 at $130 off, we are also tracking the brand new Beats 360 ANC headphones with a deep $100 price drop, a gigantic 53% off the latest Beats Studio Pro headphones, Powerbeats Pro 2 back at the best price yet, and loads more.
